cues.en: This is the Global News Podcast from the BBC World Service.
cues.zh: 这里是 BBC 世界服务的《全球新闻播客》。

cues.en: I'm Janat Jalil, and at 15:00 GMT on Friday, the 4th of September, these are our main stories.
cues.zh: 我是 Janat Jalil。现在是9月4日星期五格林尼治标准时间15点，以下是主要新闻。

cues.en: Two officials from the British anti-immigration party Reform stand down after undercover journalists filmed them talking about foreign donations.
cues.zh: 英国反移民政党 Reform 的两名官员辞职，此前卧底记者拍到他们谈论外国捐款。

cues.en: The German carmaker Volkswagen is cutting tens of thousands of jobs.
cues.zh: 德国汽车制造商大众汽车将裁减数万个岗位。

cues.en: Also in this podcast, the story of the badly injured sea eagle chick nursed back to health by his devoted parents.
cues.zh: 本期还将讲述一只严重受伤的海雕幼鸟，在父母悉心照料下恢复健康的故事。

cues.en: For an eagle to get an injury and a broken wing, that's it, normally. But he is a true survivor, and here he is, three years on, still with us.
cues.zh: 通常来说，海雕受伤并折断翅膀就很难活下来。但他是真正的幸存者，三年过去了，他依然和我们在一起。

cues.en: The past couple of years here in Britain have seen the populist anti-immigration Reform Party become a major political force.
cues.zh: 过去几年，英国民粹主义反移民政党改革党已成为一股重要政治力量。

cues.en: Its leader, Nigel Farage, is often compared to Donald Trump, and he's been talked about as a future British prime minister.
cues.zh: 该党领袖奈杰尔·法拉奇常被拿来与唐纳德·特朗普比较，也有人把他视为未来的英国首相人选。

cues.en: But this year has seen Reform embroiled in financial scandals.
cues.zh: 但今年改革党卷入了一系列财务丑闻。

cues.en: The party has repeatedly denied any wrongdoing, but now two senior officials have stepped down.
cues.zh: 该党一再否认有任何不当行为，但如今已有两名高级官员辞职。

cues.en: Undercover journalists secretly filmed party members apparently suggesting how to get around the law to secure a large foreign donation.
cues.zh: 卧底记者秘密拍下该党成员似乎在建议如何绕过法律，以获得一笔巨额外国捐款。

cues.en: Here's a clip from the video made by Verbatim Investigations and broadcast by Channel 4 News.
cues.zh: 下面是 Verbatim Investigations 制作、由第四频道新闻播出的这段视频。

cues.en: In it, you hear Mr. Farage thanking two men.
cues.zh: 视频中可以听到法拉奇先生向两名男子致谢。

cues.en: One of them is posing as an American, and the other as his British-based son.
cues.zh: 其中一人假扮美国人，另一人则假扮他在英国的儿子。

cues.en: The mechanism now for this next phase is, we've had some discussion with Dan, with James. It's all above board.
cues.zh: 下一阶段的安排是：我们已经和丹、詹姆斯进行了一些讨论，一切都合法合规。

cues.en: I'm going to be the registered donor. It'll be me.
cues.zh: 我会成为登记在册的捐款人，就是我。

cues.en: I think there'll be some conversations, necessarily with lawyers, back office and so on.
cues.zh: 我想，之后必然还要和律师、后台人员等进行一些沟通。

cues.en: But then Dad will send the money to me, and as soon as that's done and all those conversations are had, the money's available.
cues.zh: 但之后爸爸会把钱汇给我；等这一切完成、所有沟通结束后，钱就可以动用了。

cues.en: Our political correspondent, Rob Watson, told me more about the undercover investigation.
cues.zh: 我们的政治记者罗布·沃森向我进一步介绍了这次卧底调查。

cues.en: It's about 30 minutes long of television, which is utterly excruciating if you're Nigel Farage or a senior member of the Reform Party.
cues.zh: 这段电视报道长约30分钟；如果你是奈杰尔·法拉奇或改革党的高级成员，看了会极其难受。

cues.en: because what it shows in pretty graphic detail is what looks like an attempt
cues.zh: 因为它以相当直观的细节展现了一个看似这样的企图：

cues.en: by two senior Reform officials, one of them very close to Nigel Farage, essentially to get round
cues.zh: 两名改革党高级官员——其中一人与奈杰尔·法拉奇关系密切——基本上试图绕过

cues.en: Britain's election laws, which prevent political parties from getting money from abroad. I mean, it's as simple as that.
cues.zh: 英国禁止政党从海外获得资金的选举法。事情就是这么简单。

cues.en: Added to that is the sense of there being lots of meetings in places which are very expensive, very posh, in London and beyond.
cues.zh: 此外，人们还感觉他们在伦敦及其他地方一些非常昂贵、非常豪华的场所举行了许多会面。

cues.en: In other words, somewhat undermining the idea of Reform as this sort of party of the people and a party that's different to the others.
cues.zh: 换句话说，这多少削弱了改革党作为所谓人民政党、作为与其他政党不同的政党的形象。

cues.en: And Rob, the timing of this couldn't be worse for Reform, because they're holding an annual conference.
cues.zh: 罗布，这件事发生的时机对改革党来说糟糕透顶，因为他们正在举行年度大会。

cues.en: And you're there right now trying to relaunch the party after a series of recent scandals.
cues.zh: 而你此刻就在现场，试图让这个经历一连串丑闻的政党重新出发。

cues.en: That's absolutely spot on. Until fairly recently, they were leading in the opinion polls.
cues.zh: 完全正确。直到不久前，他们还在民调中领先。

cues.en: That is no longer the case. They've lost their momentum.
cues.zh: 但现在已不是这样了。他们已经失去势头。

cues.en: This conference was meant to restore momentum and present Reform as a populist right-wing party.
cues.zh: 这次大会本应恢复势头，并把改革党塑造成民粹主义右翼政党。

cues.en: It would deal with the issues that people in Britain care about, such as immigration and the cost of living.
cues.zh: 它会处理英国民众关心的问题，例如移民和生活成本。

cues.en: But this scandal goes back to what really seems to have been hitting Reform in the polling.
cues.zh: 但这起丑闻又触及了真正打击改革党民调表现的问题。

cues.en: These include concerns over its finances, the finances of its leader, Nigel Farage, and the party's finances more generally.
cues.zh: 这些担忧包括该党财务、其领袖奈杰尔·法拉奇财务，以及该党整体财务状况。

cues.en: There are also concerns about whether it wouldn't be a rather divisive force in British politics.
cues.zh: 人们还担心它会不会成为英国政治中相当具有分裂性的力量。

cues.en: There's also the bigger philosophical question of whether an insurgent populist-style party could actually govern the country.
cues.zh: 还有一个更宏观的哲学问题：一个挑战现状的民粹主义政党究竟能否治理国家。

cues.en: So this was the absolute last thing they needed as their conference kicks off. Rob Watson.
cues.zh: 所以，大会开幕之际，这正是他们最不需要发生的事。罗布·沃森报道。

cues.en: New Zealand has become only the second country after Australia to authorise psychiatrists to prescribe MDMA.
cues.zh: 新西兰成为继澳大利亚之后，全球第二个允许精神科医生开具 MDMA 的国家。

cues.en: MDMA is the active ingredient found in the party drug ecstasy.
cues.zh: MDMA 是派对毒品摇头丸中的活性成分。

cues.en: It will only be administered in a controlled clinical setting to patients with post-traumatic stress disorder.
cues.zh: 这种药物只会在受控的临床环境中，给创伤后应激障碍患者使用。

cues.en: Our global affairs reporter, Paul Moss, told me more.
cues.zh: 我们的全球事务记者保罗·莫斯向我作了进一步介绍。

cues.en: Well, this is the drug known as part of ecstasy, which makes people dance all night at rave parties. But it does seem to have clinical uses.
cues.zh: 这种药物是摇头丸的组成部分，会让人在狂欢派对上整夜跳舞。但它似乎确有临床用途。

cues.en: People don't realise that, long before it was used at parties, back in 1911 it was developed and used in psychotherapy.
cues.zh: 人们没有意识到，早在它被用于派对之前，它就于1911年被开发出来并用于心理治疗。

cues.en: The idea is that the feeling of wellbeing it induces allows people to think about traumatic events that have happened.
cues.zh: 这种观点认为，它诱发的幸福感能让人思考曾经发生的创伤。

cues.en: They might otherwise be blocking them out.
cues.zh: 否则，他们可能会把这些创伤压抑下去。

cues.en: So, in a sense, while New Zealand might think it's ahead of the curve, they're going back to the original purpose of MDMA.
cues.zh: 所以从某种意义上说，新西兰或许以为自己走在前沿，但其实是在回到 MDMA 最初的用途。

cues.en: As you suggested, it will particularly be used on people with post-traumatic stress disorder in a clinical setting.
cues.zh: 正如你所说，他们尤其会在临床环境中把它用于创伤后应激障碍患者。

cues.en: Whilst they're under the influence of MDMA, they'll be given psychotherapy, with the idea it might be more effective than otherwise.
cues.zh: 患者受 MDMA 影响期间会接受心理治疗，希望效果能比通常更好。

cues.en: Now, to some people, this might sound like quite a radical approach compared to traditional methods. Is it?
cues.zh: 对一些人来说，这与传统方法相比可能相当激进。事实是这样吗？

cues.en: Australia, New Zealand's neighbour, has done this for three years.
cues.zh: 新西兰的邻国澳大利亚已经这样做了三年。

cues.en: But using MDMA in a clinical setting is part of a growing belief among psychiatrists.
cues.zh: 但在临床环境中使用 MDMA，已成为越来越多精神科医生逐渐形成的共识之一。

cues.en: These drugs are considered mainly recreational and often illegal, but do have a clinical use.
cues.zh: 这些药物通常被视为主要用于娱乐、而且往往违法，但确实有临床用途。

cues.en: And again, there is history here.
cues.zh: 而且，这方面也有历史先例。

cues.en: Back in the 1950s, LSD was given in very small doses to people suffering from alcoholism and depression, and had some effects.
cues.zh: 早在20世纪50年代，人们就给酗酒和抑郁症患者服用极小剂量的 LSD，并取得了一些效果。

cues.en: And I should emphasise, this is always done in a clinical setting.
cues.zh: 我要强调的是，这始终是在临床环境中进行的。

cues.en: No one is suggesting that if you're feeling a bit depressed, just take an ecstasy tablet and you'll be fine.
cues.zh: 没有人建议你如果有点抑郁，就吃一片摇头丸，这样就会没事。

cues.en: But there is a growing belief that MDMA and ketamine can help people when psychotherapy alone doesn't work.
cues.zh: 但越来越多人相信，MDMA 和氯胺酮能在心理治疗单独不起作用时帮助患者。

cues.en: Yes, I think the actor Cary Grant took LSD in that setting. And magic mushrooms have also been used in those settings.
cues.zh: 是的，我记得演员加里·格兰特曾在那种环境中服用 LSD，迷幻蘑菇也曾用于这类治疗。

cues.en: But is there opposition to any of this?
cues.zh: 但有人反对这一切吗？

cues.en: There is, yes. First of all, there is a big debate about whether these drugs really are efficacious.
cues.zh: 有。首先，人们就这些药物是否真的有效展开了激烈争论。

cues.en: But you tend to get debates about any medicine used in a psychiatric circumstance.
cues.zh: 但任何用于精神科治疗的药物，往往都会引发争论。

cues.en: Think about the rows over Prozac and related antidepressants, still going on.
cues.zh: 想想围绕百忧解及相关抗抑郁药的争论，至今仍未停止。

cues.en: Is it effective? Does it have bad side effects?
cues.zh: 它有效吗？会有严重副作用吗？

cues.en: Similar debates are going on about these other psychedelic drugs.
cues.zh: 围绕其他致幻药物，也有类似争论。

cues.en: There is also political opposition. Most countries have strict laws against possession of things like LSD and ecstasy.
cues.zh: 此外还有政治上的反对。大多数国家都有严格法律，禁止持有 LSD 和摇头丸等物质。

cues.en: There are a lot of politicians very opposed to anything which might seem to be indulging or favouring these drugs.
cues.zh: 许多政治人物强烈反对任何看似纵容或偏袒这些药物的做法。

cues.en: So I think it's safe to say that, like all debates in psychiatry, this one is set to run. Paul Moss.
cues.zh: 所以可以肯定地说，和精神科领域的所有争论一样，这场争论还会持续下去。保罗·莫斯报道。

cues.en: It's not an outcome that many would have predicted, especially for an Italian leader whose party has neo-fascist roots.
cues.zh: 这对一个政党有新法西斯主义根源的意大利领导人来说，是许多人未曾预料的结果。

cues.en: But Giorgia Meloni's government has become the longest-serving in Italy since it became a republic after the Second World War.
cues.zh: 但乔治娅·梅洛尼的政府，已成为意大利自二战后成为共和国以来执政时间最长的政府。

cues.en: She is the country's first female prime minister. Clizia Sala reports.
cues.zh: 她是意大利首位女总理。克莉齐娅·萨拉报道。

cues.en: Giorgia Meloni has been in office for nearly four years, at the head of a coalition
cues.zh: 乔治娅·梅洛尼已执政近四年，领导着一个

cues.en: led by her hard-right Brothers of Italy party. She's led a period of unprecedented political stability
cues.zh: 以她所属的强硬右翼意大利兄弟党为首的执政联盟。她带来了前所未有的政治稳定时期，

cues.en: for Italy, a country that has seen 68 governments in 80 years.
cues.zh: 对意大利来说，这个国家80年间更换过68届政府。

cues.en: Her strong opinions were initially met with unease in some quarters internationally.
cues.zh: 她鲜明的观点起初在国际上引发一些方面的不安。

cues.en: But she soon built strong relations with the European Commission chief, Ursula von der Leyen.
cues.zh: 但她很快与欧盟委员会主席乌尔苏拉·冯德莱恩建立了良好关系。

cues.en: Within Italy, her supporters say she's boosted employment and implemented stricter fiscal discipline.
cues.zh: 在意大利国内，她的支持者说她促进了就业，并实施了更严格的财政纪律。

cues.en: But critics claim that her government has survived by neglecting vital structural reforms. Clizia Sala.
cues.zh: 但批评者称，她的政府是靠忽视关键结构性改革才得以维持。克莉齐娅·萨拉。

cues.en: Still to come, with thousands of migrants still in the Spanish territory of Ceuta, we hear why reports of sexual assault are rising there.
cues.zh: 本期节目稍后，我们将关注仍有数千名移民滞留西班牙属地休达，以及当地性侵报告为何增加。

cues.en: They are sleeping in the mountains and on the beach and doing everything they want
cues.zh: 他们睡在山上和海滩上，想做什么就做什么，

cues.en: without any law. They have to take them to the border again, to Morocco.
cues.zh: 完全不受法律约束。必须再次把他们带回摩洛哥边境。

cues.en: This is the Global News Podcast.
cues.zh: 这里是《全球新闻播客》。

cues.en: Germany's once-mighty car industry is in crisis, in part because of growing competition from China and its cheap electric vehicles.
cues.zh: 德国曾经强大的汽车工业正陷入危机，部分原因是来自中国及其廉价电动汽车的竞争日益加剧。

cues.en: Volkswagen is still the biggest carmaker in Europe, but the company is to cut a further 50,000 jobs by the end of this decade.
cues.zh: 大众仍是欧洲最大的汽车制造商，但公司将在本世纪20年代末前进一步裁减5万个岗位。

cues.en: That would bring the total number of planned layoffs to 100,000 and could see the closure of plants in Germany.
cues.zh: 这将使计划裁员总数达到10万人，并可能导致德国工厂关闭。

cues.en: Alexander Demling is the auto correspondent for the German magazine Der Spiegel.
cues.zh: 亚历山大·德姆林是德国《明镜》杂志的汽车业记者。

cues.en: Rob Young asked him how big a crisis this is for Volkswagen and the German car industry as a whole.
cues.zh: 罗布·扬问他，这对大众汽车乃至整个德国汽车业来说，是一场多大的危机。

cues.en: So the crisis is pretty big.
cues.zh: 这场危机相当严重。

cues.en: The German carmakers, basically, were the most globalised companies.
cues.zh: 基本上，德国汽车制造商曾是全球化程度最高的企业。

cues.en: And now, with China competing with them, they have a very big China business that's shrinking now.
cues.zh: 但如今中国正与它们竞争，它们在中国的庞大业务正在萎缩。

cues.en: That's because of the competition and because of the tariffs from Donald Trump.
cues.zh: 这是因为竞争，以及唐纳德·特朗普加征的关税。

cues.en: They are in trouble. They are still profitable, but profits are decreasing,
cues.zh: 它们陷入了困境。它们仍然盈利，但利润正在下降，

cues.en: and so they need to cut workers just to bring down costs.
cues.zh: 所以需要裁员，以降低成本。

cues.en: And how will they cut these workers? Will people be allowed to retire, maybe retire early?
cues.zh: 他们将如何裁掉这些员工？人们能否退休，或提前退休？

cues.en: Or are huge numbers of people in towns where the biggest employer is likely to be carmaking just going to be thrown out of the labour force?
cues.zh: 还是说，在最大雇主很可能是汽车制造商的城镇，大量居民将被抛出劳动力市场？

cues.en: No, it will be voluntary. So they have a job guarantee until 2030,
cues.zh: 不会，这是自愿的。他们的工作保障会持续到2030年，

cues.en: and they just need to find workers that are willing to go.
cues.zh: 他们只需找到愿意离职的员工。

cues.en: But still, 50,000 is a pretty big number, and they will look for retirees and people who are willing to look for another job.
cues.zh: 但5万人仍是一个很大的数字，他们会寻找退休人员，以及愿意另找工作的员工。

cues.en: And this will still be a big strain on these cities because you don't have productive employment anymore. You have a lot of retirees.
cues.zh: 这仍会给这些城市带来巨大压力，因为当地不再有那么多生产性就业，只有许多退休人员。

cues.en: And there are the companies that supply components and services to the likes of Volkswagen, which will also be hit,
cues.zh: 为大众等企业供应零部件和服务的公司也会受到冲击，

cues.en: if Volkswagen's planning to make a million fewer cars a year.
cues.zh: 如果大众计划每年少生产100万辆汽车。

cues.en: What is the plan for Germany's industrial base? Germany has been the economic engine of Europe for decades. Car-making lay at the heart of that,
cues.zh: 德国工业基础的计划是什么？几十年来，德国一直是欧洲的经济引擎，汽车制造业正是其核心，

cues.en: but China now poses a really big challenge to it.
cues.zh: 但如今中国对它构成了巨大挑战。

cues.en: Yeah, so I mean the plan for Volkswagen short term is moving production to Eastern and Southern Europe,
cues.zh: 是的，大众的短期计划是把生产转移到东欧和南欧，

cues.en: where they have plants that are just producing more cheaply than in Germany.
cues.zh: 那里的工厂生产成本低于德国。

cues.en: And I think the EU's plan is to force Chinese carmakers to come to Europe to produce here,
cues.zh: 我认为欧盟的计划是迫使中国汽车制造商来到欧洲，在这里生产，

cues.en: but for Germany, that's pretty dire,
cues.zh: 但对德国来说，形势相当严峻，

cues.en: because the Chinese don't want to pay German wages and deal with German unions as well.
cues.zh: 因为中国企业不想支付德国工资，也不想与德国工会打交道。

cues.en: So we're looking at a shrinking German industry for years if nothing else happens.
cues.zh: 所以，如果没有其他变化，德国工业可能会多年持续萎缩。

cues.en: And do political parties have a plan then to retrain
cues.zh: 那么，各政党是否有计划培训

cues.en: Germans to be able to get work, to set up companies,
cues.zh: 德国人，让他们能够就业、创办公司，

cues.en: for example, in a world where China dominates global carmaking in the way that Germany did in the previous century?
cues.zh: 例如，在中国像德国上世纪那样主导全球汽车制造的世界里？

cues.en: Yeah, so I mean politicians are working on, for example, transforming some of these factories to defence factories.
cues.zh: 是的，政客们正在努力，例如把其中一些工厂改造成国防工厂。

cues.en: Germany's investing a lot of money into its army because of the Russian threat,
cues.zh: 由于俄罗斯带来的威胁，德国正向军队投入大量资金，

cues.en: and so some old car factories could become defence factories.
cues.zh: 因此，一些老汽车工厂可能转为国防工厂。

cues.en: It's just the question if all of that works. I mean, the car plants are pretty big, and for a tank
cues.zh: 问题在于这些能否奏效。汽车工厂规模很大，而坦克

cues.en: plant, for example, you don't need that many workers.
cues.zh: 工厂并不需要那么多工人。

cues.en: So either we have to do it through the invisible hand of the market and just people looking for other employment,
cues.zh: 所以，要么依靠市场这只看不见的手，让人们自行寻找其他工作，

cues.en: or you have to invest much more into defence.
cues.zh: 要么就必须加大国防投入。

cues.en: And is this something that Germans are talking about, about the need to change the very nature of the country's economy,
cues.zh: 德国人是否正在讨论，是否有必要改变这个国家经济的本质，

cues.en: the way that people earn a living?
cues.zh: 改变人们谋生的方式？

cues.en: I think we're not there yet, because Germany is coming from a long stretch of prosperity,
cues.zh: 我认为我们还没走到那一步，因为德国经历了长期繁荣，

cues.en: where globalisation and the success of car industry and other industries just lifted all boats,
cues.zh: 全球化以及汽车业和其他行业的成功让所有人都受益，

cues.en: and Germans are struggling now with this moment.
cues.zh: 而德国人如今正艰难应对这一时刻。

cues.en: But I think that the change is inevitable, and the sooner people accept that other industries need to step up, the better.
cues.zh: 但我认为变化不可避免；人们越早接受其他行业需要挺身而出，情况就会越好。

cues.en: Alexander Demling of Der Spiegel.
cues.zh: 《明镜》的亚历山大·德姆林。

cues.en: The Spanish territory of Ceuta in North Africa saw a massive influx of migrants in July.
cues.zh: 北非的西班牙领土休达在7月迎来大批移民。

cues.en: In just a couple of days, around 1,700 people, most of them young men, breached the security fence separating it from Morocco.
cues.zh: 短短几天内，大约1700人（其中大多是年轻男子）越过了与摩洛哥分隔的安全围栏。

cues.en: Or simply swam across.
cues.zh: 或者干脆游了过来。

cues.en: Although most have since returned, several thousand still remain.
cues.zh: 虽然大多数人后来已经返回，但仍有几千人留在那里。

cues.en: There have been large protests across Spain over the government's handling of the crisis, with some accusing it of abandoning Ceuta.
cues.zh: 西班牙各地爆发了大规模抗议，抗议政府处理这场危机的方式，有人指责政府抛弃了休达。

cues.en: Now the authorities in the Spanish territory say 23 cases of sexual assault have been recorded there since the mass influx of migrants.
cues.zh: 如今，当地当局说，自移民大批涌入以来，已有23起性侵案件在那里被记录。

cues.en: But Ceuta's chief prosecutor says the real figure could be much higher. Sherryhan Al-Aqrah reports.
cues.zh: 但休达首席检察官说，实际数字可能高得多。谢里汉·阿克拉报道。

cues.en: In a shelter in Ceuta, women and children sit under covers trying to shield themselves from the hot sun.
cues.zh: 在休达的一处收容所，妇女和儿童坐在遮盖物下，试图躲避炎热的阳光。

cues.en: They're some of the thousands who crossed into Ceuta at the end of July.
cues.zh: 他们是7月底越境进入休达的数千人中的一部分。

cues.en: Most of them told the BBC that they left their homes in search of work in Europe.
cues.zh: 他们中的大多数人告诉BBC，自己离开家乡是为了到欧洲找工作。

cues.en: But for some, reaching Ceuta took a darker turn.
cues.zh: 但对有些人来说，到达休达却变成了一段更黑暗的经历。

cues.en: Sarah, not her real name, was sexually assaulted while sleeping in the forest.
cues.zh: 莎拉并非她的真名；她在森林里睡觉时遭到性侵。

cues.en: We've changed her name to protect her identity.
cues.zh: 我们更改了她的名字，以保护她的身份。

cues.en: A married man was next to me and touched me in inappropriate places.
cues.zh: 一个已婚男子就在我旁边，并触摸了我不该被触摸的部位。

cues.en: I tried to defend myself in that situation, moved away and made sure not to go near him again.
cues.zh: 当时我试图保护自己，离开他，并确保不再靠近他。

cues.en: I didn't want any trouble, as there were drones overhead and soldiers nearby.
cues.zh: 我不想惹麻烦，因为头顶有无人机，附近还有士兵。

cues.en: I was afraid that if I tried to flee the area, the soldiers would arrest me.
cues.zh: 我害怕如果试图逃离那里，士兵会逮捕我。

cues.en: I was caught in a difficult dilemma. I was forced to stay there until morning, and I managed to escape.
cues.zh: 我陷入了两难境地，被迫在那里待到早上，最终设法逃了出去。

cues.en: There are concerns that the number of sexual assaults in the city could be higher.
cues.zh: 有人担心，这座城市的性侵案件数量可能更高。

cues.en: Ceuta's chief prosecutor says many victims have not filed a report, out of fear or because of their current status in Ceuta.
cues.zh: 休达首席检察官说，许多受害者因为恐惧或目前在休达的身份状况而没有报案。

cues.en: Hello. Hello. Thank you for your time. Thank you for talking.
cues.zh: 你好。你好。谢谢你抽出时间。谢谢你接受采访。

cues.en: Dr. Susana Ascaso has treated several victims.
cues.zh: 苏珊娜·阿斯卡索医生治疗过几名受害者。

cues.en: The youngest, she says, was just ten years old.
cues.zh: 她说，年纪最小的受害者只有10岁。

cues.en: It's surprising for us. We are not used to that.
cues.zh: 这让我们很惊讶。我们不习惯这种情况。

cues.en: But it's horrible.
cues.zh: 但这太可怕了。

cues.en: Beyond the emergency room, Dr. Ascaso is concerned, like many others in Ceuta.
cues.zh: 除了急诊室的工作，阿斯卡索医生和休达的许多人一样，也感到担忧。

cues.en: She worries how the Spanish enclave will cope with those who remain.
cues.zh: 她担心这个西班牙飞地将如何安置留下的人。

cues.en: They are sleeping in the mountains and on the beach, and doing whatever they want without any law.
cues.zh: 他们睡在山里和海滩上，想做什么就做什么，完全没有法律约束。

cues.en: So I think they have to take care of them and get them to the border again, to Morocco.
cues.zh: 所以我认为，当局必须照顾他们，并把他们送回摩洛哥边境。

cues.en: Others like Sabah have stepped in to help.
cues.zh: 像萨巴这样的人也主动提供帮助。

cues.en: She's opened her home to feed migrants.
cues.zh: 她敞开家门，为移民提供食物。

cues.en: We met her as she prepared food. “We want to help, but the conditions are dire.”
cues.zh: 我们见到她时，她正在准备食物。“我们想提供帮助，但情况非常糟糕。”

cues.en: You see girls going through rape, sleeping in the forest.
cues.zh: 你会看到女孩遭受强奸，睡在森林里。

cues.en: Any one of them could be my daughter, my granddaughter, or a member of my own family.
cues.zh: 她们中的任何一个都可能是我的女儿、孙女，或我自己的家人。

cues.en: It's thought that there could be more than 5,000 migrants still in Ceuta.
cues.zh: 据认为，休达仍有超过5000名移民。

cues.en: Around 1,500 of them are unaccompanied minors.
cues.zh: 其中约有1500人是无人陪伴的未成年人。

cues.en: Many are being housed in shelters, but some are still sleeping outside.
cues.zh: 许多人被安置在收容所，但有些人仍睡在户外。

cues.en: In recent days, there have been growing tensions between migrants and locals.
cues.zh: 最近几天，移民与当地居民之间的紧张关系不断加剧。

cues.en: The government is under growing pressure to resolve the crisis.
cues.zh: 政府正面临越来越大的压力，必须解决这场危机。

cues.en: But for now, the migrants left in the city are waiting to find out what happens next.
cues.zh: 但目前，留在这座城市的移民正在等待，看看接下来会发生什么。

cues.en: Sherryhan Al-Aqrah reporting.
cues.zh: 谢里汉·阿克拉报道。

cues.en: A BBC investigation has found that more than 80 people have been killed
cues.zh: BBC调查发现，已有80多人在

cues.en: in a number of African countries following false claims of what's been termed genital theft.
cues.zh: 他们分布在多个非洲国家，死因与所谓的“生殖器盗窃”虚假指控有关。

cues.en: These false rumours, which are being spread on social media, allege that a simple tap on the shoulder by a stranger can cause a man's genitals to shrink or disappear.
cues.zh: 这些在社交媒体上传播的虚假谣言声称，陌生人轻拍肩膀就可能导致男性生殖器缩小或消失。

cues.en: Despite repeated assurances from doctors that there is no medical basis for these claims,
cues.zh: 尽管医生反复保证这些说法没有医学依据，

cues.en: there have been repeated mob attacks which have left entire communities gripped by fear.
cues.zh: 仍有多起私刑袭击，让整个社区陷入恐惧。

cues.en: One survivor is Boniface Amgala, a mechanic from southern Tanzania.
cues.zh: 幸存者之一是来自坦桑尼亚南部的修理工博尼法斯·阿姆加拉。

cues.en: Alfred Lasteck went to meet him.
cues.zh: 阿尔弗雷德·拉斯泰克前去采访他。

cues.en: Boniface still bears the scars of the day he nearly died in April this year.
cues.zh: 博尼法斯至今仍带着今年4月那场濒死经历留下的伤疤。

cues.en: The father of four says he had gone to a restaurant for lunch with a friend
cues.zh: 这位四个孩子的父亲说，他当时和一位朋友去餐馆吃午饭，

cues.en: when a crowd suddenly surrounded them. The crowd dragged him outside and began beating him.
cues.zh: 一群人突然包围了他们，把他拖到外面开始殴打。

cues.en: After someone accused him of stealing another man's genitals, within minutes the accusation had turned into a brutal mob attack.
cues.zh: 有人指控他偷走另一个男人的生殖器后，几分钟内这项指控就演变成残酷的私刑袭击。

cues.en: They were beating my friend over there, and I was being beaten here.
cues.zh: 他们在那边殴打我的朋友，我在这边挨打。

cues.en: We were in the ditches, and they were also throwing stones.
cues.zh: 我们当时在沟里，他们还向我们扔石头。

cues.en: It went on until I lost consciousness.
cues.zh: 他们一直打到我失去意识。

cues.en: As for my friend, they took him away to a different location and killed him there.
cues.zh: 至于我的朋友，他们把他带到另一个地方，在那里杀害了他。

cues.en: Boniface regained consciousness in hospital two days later.
cues.zh: 两天后，博尼法斯在医院恢复了意识。

cues.en: Months on, he still suffers constant headaches and sometimes walks with a limp.
cues.zh: 几个月过去，他仍饱受持续头痛之苦，有时走路一瘸一拐。

cues.en: If I walk for even an hour, I struggle and I still have to be on medication.
cues.zh: 即使只走一个小时，我也很吃力，还必须继续服药。

cues.en: And now my life has come to a standstill.
cues.zh: 现在我的生活陷入了停滞。

cues.en: I have closed my business, I am not working, and I have no support.
cues.zh: 我关闭了自己的生意，没有工作，也没有任何支持。

cues.en: My children offer their sympathies, and the two have always been crying.
cues.zh: 我的孩子们向我表示同情，他们两个一直在哭。

cues.en: Boniface says he has no idea who made the original accusations, but by then fear had already taken hold.
cues.zh: 博尼法斯说，他不知道最初是谁提出指控，但那时恐惧已经蔓延开来。

cues.en: Behind me is the Tanzania-Zambia border, one of the region's busiest trade crossings.
cues.zh: 我身后是坦桑尼亚和赞比亚边境，这是该地区最繁忙的贸易口岸之一。

cues.en: So earlier this year, the area became the centre of widespread panic after rumours of so-called genital theft,
cues.zh: 因此，今年早些时候，在所谓“生殖器盗窃”的谣言之后，这一地区陷入了广泛恐慌，

cues.en: which spread through communities on both sides of the border and on social media.
cues.zh: 谣言传遍了边境两侧的社区和社交媒体。

cues.en: Michael Silavwe, a businessman at the border of Tanzania and Zambia, witnessed one of the incidents.
cues.zh: 在坦桑尼亚与赞比亚边境经商的迈克尔·西拉维目睹了其中一起事件。

cues.en: I started hearing about genital theft through TikTok, and I took it easy.
cues.zh: 我开始通过TikTok听说“生殖器盗窃”，当时并没有太在意。

cues.en: In the evening, I saw people running. I then had to look what was going on outside my shop.
cues.zh: 傍晚时，我看到人们在奔跑，于是不得不去店外看看发生了什么。

cues.en: Upon following, I learned that a man had been caught and accused of stealing male genitals,
cues.zh: 跟过去后，我得知一名男子被抓住，并被指控偷窃男性生殖器，

cues.en: then I found some people beating the man.
cues.zh: 随后我发现有人正在殴打他。

cues.en: Several people were arrested and some were sentenced to prison in connection with other mob attacks
cues.zh: 一些人被逮捕，另一些人因参与其他私刑袭击而被判入狱，

cues.en: linked to the genital theft rumours.
cues.zh: 这些袭击都与“生殖器盗窃”谣言有关。

cues.en: Boniface says he has not pursued his own case as his priority for now
cues.zh: 博尼法斯说，他没有继续追究自己的案件，因为目前他的首要任务是

cues.en: is to recover fully from the injuries he suffered.
cues.zh: 从所受伤势中完全康复。

cues.en: Medical examinations found no evidence that anyone's genitals had disappeared.
cues.zh: 医学检查没有发现任何人的生殖器消失的证据。

cues.en: The BBC verified videos from several countries showing people being attacked.
cues.zh: BBC核实了来自多个国家的视频，显示有人遭到袭击。

cues.en: After similar accusations, the rumours had spread from the Democratic Republic of Congo to Zambia, Tanzania, Mozambique, Malawi and Kenya.
cues.zh: 在类似指控出现后，谣言从刚果民主共和国传播到赞比亚、坦桑尼亚、莫桑比克、马拉维和肯尼亚。

cues.en: As police tried to restore order, those claiming their genitals had disappeared were taken to hospital,
cues.zh: 警方试图恢复秩序时，那些声称自己生殖器消失的人被送往医院，

cues.en: but the violence continued.
cues.zh: 但暴力仍在继续。

cues.en: Elias Mwandobo is Tanzania's Mbozi District Commissioner.
cues.zh: 埃利亚斯·姆万多博是坦桑尼亚姆博齐区区长。

cues.en: An analysis and investigations suggested that the incident was rooted in superstitious beliefs,
cues.zh: 分析和调查表明，这起事件源于迷信观念，

cues.en: which is linked to criminal acts.
cues.zh: 而这种观念与犯罪行为有关。

cues.en: Essentially, individuals conspired to commit a crime and incite public panic for their own benefits.
cues.zh: 本质上，有人合谋实施犯罪，为自身利益煽动公众恐慌。

cues.en: For Boniface, the impact of that day stays with him.
cues.zh: 对博尼法斯而言，那一天的影响至今仍伴随着他。

cues.en: His injuries may heal, but the scars left by misinformation could remain for the rest of his life. That report was by Alfred Lasteck.
cues.zh: 他的伤势或许会痊愈，但虚假信息留下的伤疤可能伴随他一生。这篇报道由阿尔弗雷德·拉斯泰克完成。

cues.en: A sea eagle was badly injured as a chick when a severe storm blew his nest out of a tree.
cues.zh: 一只海雕幼鸟时期严重受伤，猛烈风暴将它的巢从树上刮落。

cues.en: It has been spotted flying in the skies off the west coast of Scotland.
cues.zh: 如今有人在苏格兰西海岸外的天空中发现了它飞行的身影。

cues.en: The eagle, known as Kinky because of his crooked wing, was not expected to survive.
cues.zh: 这只海雕因翅膀弯曲而被称为“Kinky”，原本被认为活不下来。

cues.en: But in a display of extended parental care never seen before in sea eagles, his parents sacrificed their entire next breeding season to nurse him back to health.
cues.zh: 但海雕父母展现了前所未见的长期照料：它们牺牲了整个下一繁殖季，将他养护至康复。

cues.en: Dave Sexton from the bird charity, the RSPB, says Kinky's survival is simply miraculous.
cues.zh: 鸟类保护机构皇家鸟类保护协会的戴夫·塞克斯顿说，Kinky 能活下来简直是奇迹。

cues.en: When we first saw Kinky, you know, now three years ago, he was dragging his wing along the shoreline and we thought that's it.
cues.zh: 三年前我们第一次看到 Kinky 时，他拖着翅膀沿海岸走，我们以为他就这样了。

cues.en: For an eagle to get an injury and a broken wing, that's it normally.
cues.zh: 一只海雕受了伤、折断了翅膀，通常就没救了。

cues.en: But he is a true survivor.
cues.zh: 但他是真正的幸存者。

cues.en: Seeing him again now on Mull has just upturned everything I ever thought about white-tailed eagles,
cues.zh: 如今在马尔岛再次看到他，彻底颠覆了我对白尾海雕的一切认知，

cues.en: that they have been able to look after this chick long after it should have fledged and long gone.
cues.zh: 它们竟能照料这只幼鸟，远远超过它本应长成离巢的时间。

cues.en: But they kept going. They looked after him, and now here he is, three years on, and he's still with us.
cues.zh: 但它们坚持了下来，继续照料他。三年过去，他如今还和我们在一起。

cues.en: Our science correspondent, Victoria Gill, has more.
cues.zh: 我们的科学事务记者维多利亚·吉尔将带来更多报道。

cues.en: Kinky, the sea eagle, as he's affectionately known, has become something of a local celebrity on the Isle of Mull.
cues.zh: 这只海雕名叫 Kinky，大家亲切地这样称呼他，已成为马尔岛的本地名人。

cues.en: His wing was broken when he and his nest fell from a tree during a storm back in 2023.
cues.zh: 2023 年的一场风暴中，他和巢从树上坠落，翅膀因此折断。

cues.en: In an unprecedented display of extended sea eagle parenting, his parents skipped a year's breeding season to tend to their year-old injured offspring while his wing healed.
cues.zh: 随后，海雕父母展现前所未有的长期育雏行为，跳过一年的繁殖季，照料翅膀康复中的一岁伤残幼鸟。

cues.en: Now, with a marked bump in the limb that gives Kinky his distinctive crooked silhouette, he appears to be thriving.
cues.zh: 如今，他的翅膀上有明显的隆起，形成 Kinky 独特的弯曲轮廓；他看起来茁壮成长。

cues.en: This latest sighting reveals Kinky survived the winter alone,
cues.zh: 这次最新目击显示，Kinky 独自熬过了冬天，

cues.en: but the next phase of his life, experts say, could be dangerous
cues.zh: 但专家说，他人生的下一个阶段可能会很危险，

cues.en: as he attempts to establish his own territory as an adult.
cues.zh: 因为他要尝试以成年海雕的身份建立自己的领地。

cues.en: Victoria Gill. And that's all from us for now.
cues.zh: 维多利亚·吉尔报道。以上就是目前的全部内容。

cues.en: If you want to get in touch, you can email us at globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk.
cues.zh: 如需联系我们，请发送邮件至 globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk。

cues.en: You can also now watch our episodes in full; just search for the Global News Podcast on YouTube.
cues.zh: 现在也可以在 YouTube 上观看我们的完整节目，只需搜索 Global News Podcast。

cues.en: This edition was mixed by Ricardo McCarthy and the producers were Arlene Kuchay and Oliver Burrows.
cues.zh: 本期由里卡多·麦卡锡混音，制作人是阿琳·库柴和奥利弗·伯罗斯。

cues.en: The editor is Karen Martin. I am Janat Jalil.
cues.zh: 编辑是凯伦·马丁。我是贾纳特·贾利勒。

cues.en: Until next time, goodbye.
cues.zh: 下次再会。
